description: Bonescythe Sabatons Level 60 Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Sabatons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Sabatons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Cured Rugged Hides, 2 Nexus Crystals and 25 gold pieces. Requirements: - Desecrated Sabatons - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 12 - Cured Rugged Hide x 3 - Nexus Crystal x 2 - Money: 25
